user.title: iCloud Garage Automation
user.description:
Set up automatic garage door control based on iCloud device location.

Default device names: **{my_default}** (yours) and **{wife_default}** (wife's).

data.notification_target: Alert notify service (your iPhone), e.g. notify.mobile_app_rpip
data.my_notify_service: Your iPhone location-request notify service (leave blank to auto-derive)
data.wife_notify_service: Wife's iPhone location-request notify service (leave blank to auto-derive)

data_description.notification_target: Used to push an alert to your iPhone when the garage is opened
data_description.my_notify_service: If blank, derived automatically: device_tracker.rpip → notify.mobile_app_rpip
data_description.wife_notify_service: If blank, derived automatically: device_tracker.shyiphonexs → notify.mobile_app_shyiphonexs
data_description.avg_speed_kph: Used to calculate how often to poll location when far from home (4/5 of estimated drive time)
